thread:
Ava: quick sync 1 - need 3 tight competitive claims for next week's launch content (post + webinar). audience: platform & infra buyers, SEs. keep simple.

Jamal: I propose pillars: econ predictability, dependable tail latency, unified runtime + deployment modes. each claim 1 line + two rebut bullets.

Priya: thumbs. for promo copy we should test a short benefit headline + one-line detail. examples to A/B: "Predictable price. Predictable performance." vs "One API from POC to SLA."

Luca: on benchmarks: avoid raw brag numbers. show a small "real workload" comparison (p50/p95/p99 + cost per 1M tokens) and include a 1-sentence methodology. we'll include a decile latency chart and normalize cost.

Megan: legal flagged absolutes like "always cheaper". use comparative language: "lower unit cost in common production patterns". also we need a slide that diagrams graceful degradation (fallbacks). Ops wants the flow: smaller quantized model -> region fallback -> queued requests.

Jamal: rebut templates for sales: 
- "We run our own infra": "You get the same controls but without the ongoing ops lift; plus predictable economics at scale."
- "API simplicity is fine": "We keep a simple API while adding production observability and private deployment options for regulated apps."
- "Cloud has global regions": "We route by region and provide dedicated placements to meet locality/compliance needs."

Priya: draft short promo lines: 
- "Ship reliable LLM features without overprovisioning GPUs." 
- "Same API, predictable cost and lower tail latency." 
- "From prototype to SLA-ready serving."

Luca: short methodology blurb for slide: 
`Method: 12k anonymized prompts (median 110 tokens) across two model variants. Measured p50/p95/p99 and normalized token cost. Compared hosted endpoints vs a dedicated tuned instance.`

Megan: I'll own the failure-mode slide + legal-safe phrasing. will replace any absolute claims and add the fallback diagram.

Ava: action list: Ava 1 write two headline variants + 90s webinar opener (today); Jamal 1 run 48h SE poll + collect 3 live rebut stories; Priya 1 finish promo copy variants (EOD); Luca 1 draft chart + blurb (tomorrow); Megan 1 finish fallback slide + legal review (tomorrow).

ops-bot: note created: https://notion.redwood/competitive/launch-claimpack (v1) :white_check_mark:

Jamal: I'll ping when poll returns. drop any customer soundbites here that back "predictable econ". :thumbsup:

Priya: dropping a 1-line beta quote: "After switching to Dedicated, our per-request costs stopped swinging and we could budget accurately for the quarter."

Ava: perfect. let's keep the language practical and testable. ship the promo after Jamal + Luca deliverables. :rocket:
